args: fix(scripts): prevent lib-agent-exec test suite from polluting agent-exec-issues

Updated utils.ts to completely skip writing to agent-exec-issues.jsonl if process.env.NODE_ENV is 'test' or AGENT_EXEC_SILENT is '1'. This prevents the lib-agent-exec test suite (which intentionally simulates execution errors to verify fault-tolerance) from writing false-positive '? Error:' entries to the global log file during normal CI/iteration.
